title: Purpose Codes
sectionDescription: Collecting money and the objects it touches.
content:
# Purpose Codes

Purpose codes come from a fixed, regulator-defined set. Use the published payin and payout lists; do not invent a value.

title: Webhooks
content:
# Webhooks

Verify the X-Glomopay-Signature header using HMAC SHA-256 before processing any webhook payload.
